sourceDescription: AI-generated decal artwork developed from the user-supplied reference. Original authorship and publication were not independently verified.

/vector/decal/circular-throne-room.svg.approval: Required monochrome companion derived from the approved three-color design and previewed in the conversation. The user did not separately approve this bitmap.
/vector/decal/circular-throne-room.svg.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 8, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.25, followed by SVG authoring root and provenance steps, uniform square normalization and the decal optimization profile.
/vector/decal/circular-throne-room.svg.paint: Inherited from the caller. Internal details remain transparent cutouts.
/vector/decal/circular-throne-room.svg.details: The central disk is transparent to keep the throne legible in one ink. The arches, stairs and architectural arrangement follow the approved color design.

/vector/decal/circular-throne-room-multi.approval: The user explicitly approved this bitmap proposal on 2026-10-26.
/vector/decal/circular-throne-room-multi.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 8, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.25, followed by SVG authoring root and provenance steps, uniform square normalization and the decal optimization profile.
/vector/decal/circular-throne-room-multi.paint: Three flat layers use #090907, #25394e and #efe7bc. The navy matches the existing Stronghold Tabr multicolor decal.
/vector/decal/circular-throne-room-multi.details: Cream concentric arches and a circular disk surround a navy throne and stair runner, with black structural cuts.
